rationale: SKM gapped down ~8.55% at the open and is now trading near the session low (position in range: 9.8%), with the last five 1-minute candles showing tight, indecisive oscillation between $27.38 and $27.50 — no clear directional momentum in either direction. Sitting out until a cleaner directional signal emerges is the prudent choice.
